releaseNotes: Ordrili Catch 1.2.3: connect to your restaurant's Hub on site — the server panel shows the Hub's live status, finds it again when its network address changes, works with Windows Hubs, and has a Disconnect button. A clear screen now explains an expired add-on or restaurant access. Sign in with your staff account, see your Call History on Home, and caught calls report to the Ordrili dashboard automatically.
